verdict.rationale: Lighthouse's pricing page explicitly separates its own flat-price service from government costs. It lists USCIS filing fees (about $1-3k, varying by company size) and premium processing fees (about $3K) as 'Not included', and states 'one flat price and no surprise fees' with no extra charge for RFE responses. missing for 10: Lighthouse's own fee dollar amounts are not shown in the evidence (so the all-in total cannot be fully computed), no independent or hands-on corroboration that invoices match the page.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's pricing pages separate its own fees from USCIS filing fees and premium processing, so the all-in cost is honest

citations.quote: Not included: USCIS filing fees, typically around $1-3k and varying by company size, and Premium Processing fees, around $3K.
every case comes with one flat price and no surprise fees.
Lighthouse does not charge additional fees for preparing responses to Requests for Evidence.
